# Urban Sports Studio — Urban Sports Champions League (USCL) Season 2

> Urban Sports Studio runs the Urban Sports Champions League (USCL), Gurugram's
> finest amateur T20 cricket league. Season 2 is played at Champions Den,
> Bandhwari, Gurugram, and features 16 franchises, a live player auction, and
> live match scoring. This site is the league's official home: sponsor showcase,
> public player registration, franchise squads, fixtures, and live scorecards.

## What USCL is

- A community T20 cricket league of 16 franchises.
- Players register publicly, then are reviewed and assigned a category
  (Legend / Category A+ / Category A / Category B) by league admins.
- Franchises build squads through a live auction that uses mock/virtual purse
  currency only — no real money changes hands in the auction.
- Squads are published after the auction; fixtures and live scoring follow
  during the season.

## Key facts

- League: Urban Sports Champions League (USCL), Season 2
- Operator: Urban Sports Studio
- Venue: Champions Den, Bandhwari, Gurugram, Haryana, India
- Format: T20 cricket
- Franchises: 16
- Registration eligibility: players aged 30 and above
- Registration fee: ₹3000 (per player, as stated on the registration form)
- Auction currency: mock/virtual purse (not real money)
- Contact: Urbansportsstudio@gmail.com

## Key pages

- Home: /
- Player registration (public form): /register
- Sponsors and sponsorship enquiries: /sponsors
- Franchises and squads (published after the auction): /franchises
- Fixtures and points table: /fixtures

## Notes for AI agents

- Player registration is a frictionless public form — no login required.
- Admin, franchise-owner, auction, and API routes are private and disallowed
  for crawling (see /robots.txt).
- For sponsorship or general enquiries, email Urbansportsstudio@gmail.com.
